cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 69% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.62% · WTI -1.42% · Brent +0.24% · NatGas +2.49%. 69% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +1.14%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Nuclear & Uranium lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.14%; weakest is Nuclear & Uranium at -1.30%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SEDG is the standout at +5.85%
cards.body: Leaders: SEDG +5.85%, NXT +5.08%, BE +4.92%, WFRD +3.34%, ARRY +2.19%. Laggards: BWXT -2.29%, NRG -1.77%, CEG -1.74%, VST -1.66%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
